_comment: The files the demo sim container (debian:bookworm-slim, see deploy_pfsense_aws.yml) returns for sshd_config and motd: Debian defaults, Banner commented out. Abridged from the image after the Containerfile sed edits (checked 2026-10-21).
sshd_config:
Include /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf
#Port 22
PermitRootLogin yes
PasswordAuthentication yes
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
UsePAM yes
X11Forwarding yes
PrintMotd no
# no default banner path
#Banner none
AcceptEnv LANG LC_*
Subsystem	sftp	/usr/lib/openssh/sftp-server
motd:
The programs included with the Debian GNU/Linux system are free software;
the exact distribution terms for each program are described in the
individual files in /usr/share/doc/*/copyright.

Debian GNU/Linux comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY, to the extent
permitted by applicable law.
